test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Chandigarh is a model city with sectors that are ______ with spaces for living, working and leisure.
solution: The correct answer is** 'self-sufficient'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is **'self-sufficient'.** • It means** 'able to produce or provide everything that you need without help from or having to buy from others'.** (आत्‍मनिर्भर) • *Example: This enabled the country to become **self-sufficient** in sugar. * • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4**. **Correct Sentence:__** *Chandigarh is a model city with sectors that are** __self-sufficient__ **with spaces for living, working and leisure.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **self-righteous**: believing that you are always right and other people are wrong so that you are better than other people. [स्‍वयं को हमेशा सही (और दूसरों को ग़लत) और इसलिए ख़ुद को दूसरों से बेहतर मानने वाला; दंभी] • **inferior**: low or lower in social position, importance, quality, etc. (सामाजिक स्थिति, महत्व, गुणवत्ता आदि की दृष्टि से निम्‍न या निम्‍नतर स्‍तर का; घटिया, निकृष्‍ट) • **dependent**: needing somebody/something to support you. (किसी पर निर्भर, पराश्रित) 33:Tacb, The correct answer is '**Scatterbrain**'.
